hero.statement: I build the distributed systems and async engines behind money movement, AI tooling, and high-availability platforms.
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer with 6+ years designing and operating production systems for fintech, applied AI, and enterprise platforms. I specialize in TypeScript/Node.js, Python, and event-driven architecture on AWS/GCP — from payment gateways processing 500k+ monthly transactions to multi-agent orchestration with sub-50ms M2M latency.
I care about clean boundaries, observable systems, and shipping outcomes. Italian (EU) citizen, authorized to work in the EU without sponsorship; remote across CET and EST.

experience.title: Where I've shipped
experience.subtitle: Production systems across fintech, applied AI, and cloud infrastructure.

bullets: Designed and shipped a distributed asynchronous engine for regulatory reports in Fastify and Python, using BullMQ and Redis to cut processing time by 65% while handling 2,000+ documents per month.
Co-designed the agentic core for AI tool distribution — multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous execution loops — with token-authenticated M2M APIs at sub-50ms latency.
Built a secure event pipeline between isolated customer VPCs and the central platform, processing 10,000+ daily events with guaranteed consistency and zero public endpoints.
Standardized agent-assisted SDLC workflows, cutting microservice refactoring from multi-day cycles to under two days and expanding automated test coverage.
Operated distributed services across AWS and GCP at 99.9% availability, containerized with Docker and delivered through zero-downtime CI/CD with Sentry and CloudWatch observability.

Built the end-to-end cross-platform mobile architecture (iOS and Android) in React Native and TypeScript for a credit origination platform, delivering 20+ modular views: biometric KYC onboarding, analytics, transactions, history, and real-time chat.
Designed and operated the cloud data layer, implementing authentication and granular Row-Level Security (RLS) policies to protect sensitive credit histories and financial contracts.
Improved cold-start load time and added offline persistence for loan applications and transactions in low-connectivity environments.
Maintained 99.9% availability across mission-critical payment gateway services processing 500,000+ monthly transactions in Node.js (Express), TypeScript, and MySQL.

Engineered financial resilience and idempotency with Circuit Breakers, rate limiting, and AWS SQS queues with Dead Letter Queues (DLQ), guaranteeing zero duplicate charges during banking gateway outages.
Reduced p95 transaction latency by optimizing complex MySQL queries, offloading notifications to asynchronous SQS workers, and refactoring critical endpoints.
Led payment gateway integrations for merchants and partners across React web apps and REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, backed by Jest test suites and Datadog/Sentry monitoring.
Designed and developed 3 modular internal applications in JavaScript, Node.js, and Python for commercial operations, used daily in production.
Maintained continuous availability with zero unplanned downtime on production Linux servers using NGINX reverse proxies, load balancing, and SSL/TLS policies.
Reduced developer onboarding time by standardizing 15+ API contracts and system blueprints with OpenAPI/Swagger.
